task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Lead the civil response: convene emergency session, appoint physicians, secure grain and water supplies, order collection and burial of the dead, and coordinate day-to-day public-health measures.
Frame and ratify emergency decrees: quarantine rules, allocation of public funds, temporary curfews or assembly limits, and empower the archon to act between sessions.
Enforce orders and run logistics: cordon lines, supply distribution, hospital/temporary-care sites, and maintain civic order so the archon's measures can be carried out.
